newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 50,000 tonnes durum wheat for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 50,000 tonnes durum wheat for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 50,000 tonnes of hard durum amber wheat for sale, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.
March 8 was the final date for receiving bids and results would be announced on March 9.
The wheat, from the 1995 crop, would be ready for shipment between April 15 and May 15.
Partial offers would be accepted and partial shipment allowed, the official said.
